scope: The 146 ACTIVE formal-unit mappings in the audited Typed Slotted E-Graphs paper snapshot.

paper_source_normal_form.input: The inclusive UTF-8 source span recorded for one formal unit.
steps: Convert CRLF and CR line endings to LF.
Remove TeX comments beginning at an unescaped percent sign.
Remove only the complete leanref tag that identifies the unit.
Collapse every remaining whitespace run to one ASCII space and trim both ends.
paper_source_normal_form.hash_algorithm: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 paper source normal form

lean_type_normal_form.input: The exact elaborated declaration type obtained from the Lean 4.33.0 environment.
steps: Pretty-print the elaborated type with the fixed options above.
Convert CRLF and CR line endings to LF.
Collapse every whitespace run to one ASCII space and trim both ends.
lean_type_normal_form.hash_algorithm: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 Lean type normal form

mechanically_derived_metadata.provenance: Defining module and declaration range from the Lean 4.33.0 environment.
mechanically_derived_metadata.hypotheses: The outer elaborated telescope, retaining binder name, binder kind, and exact elaborated binder type.
mechanically_derived_metadata.dependencies: Direct constants used by the declaration body, filtered to distinct ACTIVE mapped declarations; transitive dependencies are the closure of those direct edges.
mechanically_derived_metadata.controlled_english: normative_statement is a reviewer-facing paraphrase and is never substituted for either mechanical normal form or hash.

permitted: Transparent unfolding of the mapped declaration itself, including its structure fields or inductive constructor surface.
forbidden: Theorem rewriting or use of an unrecorded lemma.
Changing binder explicitness or binder order.
Changing the identity of a relation, the direction of an equality, or the order of conjuncts.
Adding semantic qualifiers or implementation claims absent from the elaborated type.
Treating prose similarity or a controlled-English paraphrase as normalized equality.

change_control.amendment_rule: Any change creates a new contract identifier and invalidates all reviews performed under this identifier.
